claims.label: At least 130 drones in the night to Tuesday
claims.text: According to the Ukrainian Air Force's first morning summary on Tuesday 24 November 2026, Russia launched at least 130 drones at Ukraine in the night of 23-24 November (from 18:00 Kyiv time on 23 November).
claims.criterion: YES if the Ukrainian Air Force's first summary of the overnight attack published on Tue 24 Nov 2026 (Kyiv time), covering the attack counted from 18:00 Kyiv time on 23 Nov, gives a UAV total of 130 or more, as published on the Air Force's Telegram channel (t.me/kpszsu) or Facebook page or repeated by Ukrinform, Ukrainska Pravda, Kyiv Independent or Interfax-Ukraine. Drones means strike UAVs as the summary counts them (Shahed-type and jet-powered Shaheds, Gerbera, Parodiya and other decoys, and any jet munitions such as Banderol/Dan-T that the summary includes in its UAV total); missiles listed separately are not counted. A summary issued late in the morning or around noon still counts as the first summary; separate daytime reports and later corrections do not count. NO if the total is 129 or fewer, or if the Air Force reports that no drones were launched that night. If no summary for that night has been published, the claim stays pending.

cs.label: Nejméně 130 dronů v noci na úterý
cs.text: Podle prvního ranního souhrnu ukrajinského letectva z úterý 24. listopadu 2026 Rusko v noci na 24. listopadu (od 18:00 kyjevského času 23. listopadu) vyslalo proti Ukrajině nejméně 130 dronů.
cs.criterion: ANO, pokud první souhrn nočního útoku, který ukrajinské letectvo zveřejní v úterý 24. listopadu 2026 (kyjevského času) a který zahrnuje útok počítaný od 18:00 kyjevského času 23. listopadu, uvede celkem 130 nebo více bezpilotních letounů, jak je zveřejněn na telegramovém kanálu letectva (t.me/kpszsu) nebo jeho facebookové stránce či jak jej převezmou Ukrinform, Ukrajinska pravda, Kyiv Independent nebo Interfax-Ukrajina. Drony jsou útočné bezpilotní letouny tak, jak je souhrn počítá (drony typu Šáhed včetně proudových, Gerbera, Parodija a jiné klamné drony a také proudové střely jako Banderol/Dan-T, pokud je souhrn zahrnuje do celkového počtu dronů); rakety uvedené zvlášť se nepočítají. Souhrn vydaný pozdě dopoledne nebo kolem poledne se stále počítá jako první souhrn; samostatné denní zprávy a pozdější opravy se nepočítají. NE, pokud souhrn uvede 129 nebo méně dronů nebo pokud letectvo oznámí, že té noci žádné drony vyslány nebyly. Pokud souhrn za tuto noc nebude zveřejněn, tvrzení zůstává otevřené.

research.question: What will the Commission conclude on France's 2027 DBP — does France's planned 2027 net expenditure growth respect the 1.2% annual / 7.1% cumulative Council path?
research.finding: According to the HCFP opinion, France's PLF puts 2027 net expenditure growth at 0.7% against the 1.2% cap. Cumulative growth since 2023 would be 6.6% against 7.1% in 2027, a 0.5-point margin both ways, although 2026 would be slightly over (1.4% vs 1.2%; cumulative 5.9 vs 5.8). The Commission's 17 Nov forecast for France explicitly builds in the draft budget's measures (about 0.8% of GDP on spending and 0.7% on revenue). It puts the small deficit improvement down to growth and interest, which the net-expenditure test excludes. Last year's 'complies' opinion used the same method: the Commission forecast with the DBP folded in, checking the plan year annually and cumulatively. No leak or preview of this year's opinion was found.

stories.event: Portugal's parliament holds the final overall vote (votação final global) on the 2027 state budget (OE2027) on Tuesday 24 November, at a plenary moved to 15:00 Lisbon time after the Chega convention cut Friday's specialty votes short. The minority AD government (91 of 230 seats) passed the generality vote on 28 Oct thanks to PS abstention; in the specialty stage PS and Chega together passed tax changes against the government (VAT-free food basket financed by ending the 10% IRS rate for landlords, tuition freeze), which Montenegro called a 'manta de retalhos fiscal' while denying a political crisis. The budget passes unless both PS and Chega vote against.

stories.event: The European Parliament votes in Strasbourg on Tue 24 Nov 2026 on its first-reading position on the Commission's regulation to speed up environmental assessments (Omnibus VIII, 2025/0391(COD), rapporteur Emma Ytterell, Renew). The ENVI committee text caps the whole assessment at 300 days; it passed committee only 36–35 with 11 abstentions, S&D, Greens and the Left voting against over weaker protection of birds' nests and eggs. EPP, Renew and S&D have tabled joint compromise amendments on protected species for the plenary.

claim_record.label: Refinery tax passed on Tuesday
claim_record.text: The Chamber of Deputies passes the extraordinary refinery tax bill (the windfall tax on refinery margins, "lex Orlen") in third reading on Tuesday 24 November 2026.
claim_record.criterion: YES if, between 00:00 and 23:59 on Tue 24 Nov 2026 (Europe/Prague), the Chamber of Deputies adopts in third reading (final passage vote) the government bill introducing an extraordinary tax on refineries' increased margins, in any amended form, as shown by the psp.cz vote record or reported by ČTK, ČT24 or another major Czech outlet. NO if no such passage vote is held on 24 Nov (item not reached, interrupted or postponed to a later day) or if the bill is rejected. A report published after midnight about a vote held on 24 Nov counts.
